conflicts.name: Russia–Ukraine War
conflicts.summary: Full-scale war since Feb 2022. Disrupts global energy, coal, grain, fertilizer and sunflower-oil supply. India stays officially neutral and has become a major buyer of discounted Russian crude.
escalation_triggers: Attacks on energy export infrastructure / Black Sea grain corridor
Secondary sanctions on buyers of Russian crude

conflicts.name: India–Pakistan Tensions
conflicts.summary: Long-standing rivalry with periodic flare-ups (Kashmir, cross-border terror, border skirmishes). Direct-belligerent scenario for India: raises defense spending, hits risk sentiment, pressures the rupee.
escalation_triggers: Major terror attack attributed across the border

conflicts.name: Israel–Iran / Middle East Conflict
conflicts.summary: Escalating regional conflict threatening the Strait of Hormuz, through which a large share of India's crude and LNG imports pass. Primary channel to India is oil price and shipping/insurance costs.
escalation_triggers: Threat to close / mine the Strait of Hormuz

conflicts.name: China–Taiwan Tensions
conflicts.summary: Latent flashpoint. A blockade or conflict would disrupt global semiconductor supply and shipping. India both competes with and depends on this supply chain; also colours India–China border sentiment.

conflicts.name: India–China Border Standoff
conflicts.summary: Frozen border standoff (LAC). Direct-belligerent risk for India. Feeds import-substitution / 'China+1' and defense-indigenization themes; China is India's largest source of imports (electronics, APIs, machinery, rare earths).
escalation_triggers: Import curbs / retaliation on Chinese goods
Supply cut of active pharma ingredients (APIs) or rare earths

conflicts.name: US–China Tech & Trade War
conflicts.summary: Escalating tech/trade decoupling — semiconductor export controls, tariffs, and rare-earth counter-measures. Accelerates supply chains shifting to India ('China+1'), but disrupts global electronics and chip availability.
escalation_triggers: Chinese rare-earth or gallium/germanium export curbs

conflicts.name: Red Sea / Houthi Shipping Crisis
conflicts.summary: Attacks on Red Sea shipping force diversions around the Cape of Good Hope, raising freight, insurance and transit times. Directly hits India's export competitiveness (to Europe) and import costs.

conflicts.name: Gulf / OPEC+ Supply Risk
conflicts.summary: Gulf instability and OPEC+ production decisions swing crude prices. India imports a large share of crude from the Gulf; a supply cut or regional escalation is a direct oil-price shock.

conflicts.name: South China Sea Dispute
conflicts.summary: Maritime disputes over a critical global shipping and trade artery. Escalation would disrupt East-Asian trade routes and electronics/component flows relevant to Indian manufacturers.

conflicts.name: Venezuela Sanctions / Supply
conflicts.summary: Sanctions swings on Venezuelan crude affect global heavy-crude supply. India historically bought Venezuelan barrels; easing/tightening shifts crude sourcing and prices.

conflicts.name: Korean Peninsula Tensions
conflicts.summary: Periodic missile tests and escalation risk. Limited direct India trade exposure, but a serious flare-up would trigger global risk-off, hitting emerging-market equities and the rupee.
escalation_triggers: Disruption to South Korean chip/electronics output

conflicts.name: Bangladesh Political Instability
conflicts.summary: Political turmoil in a key neighbour. Bangladesh is a global garment-export hub and India's rival in apparel; disruption there redirects orders to Indian textile exporters, while raising border, migration and regional-stability concerns for India.
escalation_triggers: Prolonged shutdown of Bangladeshi garment factories

conflicts.name: Myanmar Civil Conflict
conflicts.summary: Ongoing civil war on India's north-eastern border. Limited direct market channel, but it pressures border security, the Kaladan connectivity project, and drives defense/border spending; also a source of instability and illicit trade in India's northeast.
escalation_triggers: Disruption of the Kaladan transit corridor
